title: Chorta Hoon Mei Vatan Deen Ko Bachanay Kai Leeyai
body:
Jo Kia Wada Azal Mein Wo Nibhanay Kay Leeyai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ker Diya Majboor Mujhko Karnay Aaya Hoon Salaa (x2)
Ja Raha Hoon Kerbala Wapis Na Aanay Kay Leeyai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aagaya Wo Din Bhi Shidat Say Tha Jis Ka Intezaar (x2)
Baithi Hai Tayaar Zainab Saath Janay Kay Leeyai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hogaeen Nana Mukamil Sub Meri Qurbaaniyan (x2)
Agaya Duniya Mei Asghar Teer Khanay Kay Leeyai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kanpthay Hain Saray Insan Moth Ki Dehleez Per (x2)
Dil Ali Asghar Ka Chahiyai Muskuranay Kay Leeyai
<<DIVIDER>>
Darti Hai Zainab Abhi Thak Khoon Rota Hai Sajjad (x2)
Phir Koi Isko Na Kehday Shaam Janay Kay Leeyai
<<DIVIDER>>
Sookhay Lub Masooma Kai Daikhay Tho Ghazi Nai Kaha (x2)
Ja Raha Hoon Mein Sakina Paani Lanay Kay Leeyai
<<DIVIDER>>
Dhal Gaya Ashoor Ka Din Cha Gaee Tanveer Raat (x2)
Aag Lathay Hain Shaqi Khaimay Jalanay Kay Leeyai
